text:
Maya: Heads-up: follow-up on last week's billing spike incident — want to capture remediation owners/timelines and invoice correction plan. Short thread.

Jordan: Agree. Quick summary: delayed usage pipeline caused ~2 days of delayed token counts for ~4% of customers, invoices generated before catchup. Need credits & fix.

Alejandro: I have the reconciliation query ready, running it now. Example: ```SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens) AS tokens FROM usage_events WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-12' GROUP BY customer_id;``` Will dedupe by event_id.

Samira: OK — can you own reconciliation (A1) and produce CSV of affected customers by EOD Thu? I'll own invoice corrections & customer comms (A2).

Maya: Assigning owners: A1 = Alejandro (reconcile), A2 = Samira (invoice corrections), A3 = Jordan (pipeline fix), A4 = Eve (monitoring/alerting). Target dates: A1 Thu EOD, A2 Fri 12:00, A3 next Tue, A4 next Wed.

Jordan: Root cause recap: batching job hit backpressure + S3 eventual consistency for offset markers. Short-term: re-run backfill with dedupe. Long-term: checkpointing rewrite + stronger consumer commits.

Alejandro: Running reconcile now. Quick log excerpt: ```INFO ReconcileJob start=1750000000 rows_scanned=1_200_000 potential_duplicates=8``` Will upload CSV to shared drive when done.

billing-bot: Billing system: created credit_adjustment_#9876 for 24 accounts. Status: pending.

Samira: Thanks — I need final amounts and invoice IDs to apply credits. Alej please add columns: affected_amount_usd, original_invoice_id, computed_credit_usd.

Alejandro: Will add columns. ETA 16:30 PST.

Maya: :thumbsup: Can everyone update the shared remediation tracker (https://redwood.internal/trackers/billing-1750) with blockers. Also add recurring-incident note to postmortem: 'delayed usage > billing window' and propose quarterly audit.

Eve (Eng-SRE): I'll add an alert rule: if usage ingestion lag > 1h for >10% of customers -> pager. Setting dashboard and adding runbook.

Samira: Drafting customer comms: short apology + credit + timeline + link to support. Posting in #customer-success for review before send.

Jordan: Finance ops request: can we add a script to flag invoices generated >24h before final usage reconciliation when variance >1%? (A5) Owner: FinanceOps (TBD).

Maya: Action items recap (compact):
- A1 Alejandro — reconcile CSV (Thu EOD)
- A2 Samira — invoice corrections & customer comms (Fri 12:00)
- A3 Jordan — pipeline fix (next Tue)
- A4 Eve — alerting & dashboard (next Wed)
- A5 FinanceOps — invoice-variance script (TBD)

Samira: I'll follow up on credit issuance once billing-bot confirms processed so we can notify customers.

billing-bot: Credit adjustments applied: 24 accounts, processed_ts=1750001700. Notifications queued.

Jordan: Thanks. Can we do a 30-min wrap sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to verify A1/A2 and close loop?

Maya: Scheduled — calendar invite sent. Thanks all.
